articles.summary: PhenixFIN Corporation (NASDAQ: PFX) reported its fiscal Q2 2025 results with total investment income of $6.0 million and net investment income of $1.0 million. The company's NAV stood at $159 million ($78.72 per share) as of March 31, 2025. PhenixFIN paid a special dividend of $1.43 per share on February 19, 2025. The company's portfolio, valued at $286.8 million, included 36 portfolio companies with a weighted average yield of 11.82% on debt investments. Notably, PhenixFIN secured an extension and upsize of its credit facility to April 2030 and $100 million, with reduced funding costs from SOFR+290 to SOFR+250. The quarter saw a net realized loss of $1.1 million and an unrealized loss of $0.5 million.
articles.title: PhenixFIN Corporation Announces Fiscal Second Quarter 2025 Financial Results
